metaTitle: How to Ventilate a Tent in Hot Weather
description: Cool a hot tent with cross-ventilation, shade, a taut rain fly and a small fan. Includes how airflow works and what to look for in a summer tent.
directAnswer: Open vents low and high and on opposite sides, keep the fly off the inner tent, pitch in shade facing the breeze, and add a small fan if the air is still. Good cross-flow can cut interior heat and condensation sharply.
